theorem mvcc.keyImageM_recsPos (L : mvcc.Log) (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) (D : backend.Data) (h :
    mvcc.keyImageM true L r D) : mvcc.recsPos r

theorem mvcc.keyImageM_crev (cm : Bool) (L : mvcc.Log) (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) (D : backend.Data) (h :
    mvcc.keyImageM cm L r D) : -1 ≤ r.crev ∧ (cm = false → r = mvcc.CmpRecs.empty)

def mvcc.keyImageM (cm : Bool) (L : mvcc.Log) (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) (D : backend.Data) : Prop :=
  if cm = true then
    ∃ ents,
      (∀ (k : GoString), backend.dget D mvcc.keyName k = mvcc.bucketOfEnts ents !! k) ∧
        backend.dget D go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.metaName mvcc.finKeyBytes = mvcc.recBytes r.fin ∧
          backend.dget D go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.metaName mvcc.schedKeyBytes = mvcc.recBytes r.sched ∧
            mvcc.recsOk L r ∧ mvcc.recsPos r ∧ mvcc.entsCutAt L r.crev ents
  else mvcc.keyImage L D ∧ r = mvcc.CmpRecs.empty

theorem mvcc.recBytes_metaRevVal {x : Option w64} {v : GoString} (hx : ∀ (y : w64), x = some y → 1 ≤
    sint.Z y) (h : mvcc.recBytes x = some v) : mvcc.metaRevVal v
